top_signals.title: Climate Startup Signs CO2 Deals With Three U.S. Oil Producers
top_signals.summary: Cuts to U.S. federal incentives for carbon capture projects and an uncertain regulatory environment going forward have prompted some start-ups to move from solely capturing and storing carbon dioxide to selling it to oil companies to help them boost oil recovery.   Carbon management engineering company Spiritus, for example, has recently signed preliminary agreements with three U.S. oil and gas producers to sell them the captured CO2 for enhanced oil recovery (EOR).  The injection of CO2 into reservoirs could help unlock an additional…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: McDonald's CEO expects high inflation, flat traffic are not going away for restaurant industry
top_signals.summary: McDonald's CEO Chris Kempczinski said that he expects that high inflation and flat traffic will continue to weigh on the restaurant industry.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: UK’s 250th banking hub opens in Chepstow, keeping access to cash and face-to-face banking in the town
top_signals.summary: Treasury Minister Lucy Rigby officially opens the UK's 250th banking hub in Chepstow
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: IonQ shares rise after company says it made a major quantum computing breakthrough
top_signals.summary: Shares of quantum computing company IonQ surged in premarket trading following its successful test of the industry's first real time end-to-end error decoder.
